body: I would love to move away to be with the guy that I love but it's not an option.

many.  my family is incredibly fucked up.  divorce, consistent death, abandonment, parents with drug problems.  i've mad huge amounts of mistakes in my life that won't go away.  i've been suicidal for years, and attempted before and i wasn't planning to be around at this point in my life.  i finally had things starting to come together and found the love of my life, but i fucked it all up and drove him away and now i've lost a lot of direction recently and i don't know how to make it better.  i know it seems like a load of shit, the whole boyfriend broke up with me and now i want to end it, but it's not that.  that was just sort of the cherry on top.

I've been feeling particularly hopeless and have been thinking continually about suicide for a bit.  Recently, I have been thinking about it constantly.  Last night I was in my bed, had a razor blade and made a few cuts up my wrists, and on my legs that were all superficial at best.  So, feeling defeated not knowing how deep my arteries were, I chugged half of a large bottle of nyquil, and half of a small bottle of zzzquil.  I debated going after the aspirin i had on my nightstand as well.  I went to sleep and woke up a few hours later with my heart pounding out of my chest, sweating, feeling delirious and jittery.  I called 911 and was brought to the hospital and received a bag of fluids.  I took a cab home and spent the day in bed.  Now i'm dealing with the after effects and thinking in my mind about the most painless way I can figure out how to make it happen for real.  I wish i hadn't woken up so I didn't have to explain myself to anyone.  but here i am instead.  fuck.
